description: Agent-based social adoption model on a dynamic contact network with policy-driven exogenous exposure and heterogeneous thresholds/susceptibility. The model simulates daily interactions, influence accumulation, adoption and abandonment, and aggregates observables to match external data.

modules.name: SocialNetworkBuilder
modules.description: Constructs the initial contact network with homophily and clustering using a degree-corrected SBM and triadic closure.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if t == 0:
  N = parameters.population_size
  nA = round(N * parameters.group_share_A)
  assign first nA nodes to group 'A', rest to 'B'
  sample degree targets k_i ~ NegBin(mean=parameters.average_degree, dispersion=parameters.degree_dispersion_k)
  construct DC-SBM probabilities P[group_u, group_v] with homophily parameters.homophily_index
  generate multi-graph by stub-matching with group-aware probabilities, then simplify to simple graph
  apply triadic closure: for each node, with prob parameters.clustering_triads_prob, connect two neighbors if not already connected
  output signal.network_graph, signal.node_groups, signal.node_degrees
else:
  pass
notes: Degree-corrected SBM uses group mixing matrix derived from homophily_index: higher value increases within-group edge probability.

modules.name: TemporalContactActivation
modules.description: Activates a daily subset of edges and performs low-rate rewiring to reflect changing contacts.

notes: Rewiring preserves degree but adjusts partners, maintaining homophily via candidate selection.

modules.name: PolicyCampaign
modules.description: Allocates daily exogenous exposure to agents based on budget and targeting strategy; modifies effective thresholds via exposure.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if t < parameters.campaign_start_day or t > parameters.campaign_end_day:
  exposure_i = parameters.exogenous_exposure_base for all i
  thresh_red_i = 0 for all i
else:
  base = parameters.exogenous_exposure_base
  B = parameters.campaign_budget_per_day
  dollars_per_person = strategy_allocation(parameters.targeting_strategy, signal.network_graph, signal.node_groups, state.person_adopted)
  for each person i:
    addl_exposure = dollars_per_person[i] * parameters.exposure_per_dollar
    effective_exposure = base + addl_exposure
    if Bernoulli(parameters.compliance_probability) == 1:
      exposure_i = effective_exposure
      thresh_red_i = parameters.threshold_reduction_per_exposure * effective_exposure
    else:
      exposure_i = base
      thresh_red_i = 0
policy.exposure_vector = exposure_i
policy.threshold_reduction_vector = thresh_red_i
notes: strategy_allocation returns a per-person budget allocation vector summing to B.
Examples: 'degree_top10' allocates proportionally to node degree among top decile; 'random' uniform; 'group_A_priority' allocates more to group A.

modules.name: InteractionDynamics
modules.description: Computes social influence, applies adoption and abandonment, and updates individual states.

notes: Linear-threshold-like rule with heterogeneous thresholds and susceptibilities.
Refractory period prevents immediate re-adoption after dropout.

modules.name: AdoptionAggregator
modules.description: Aggregates daily and cumulative adoption observables with optional smoothing and reporting delay.

update_rule.pseudocode:
N = number of persons
adopted_count = sum(state.person_adopted)
rate = adopted_count / N
new_rate = event.new_adoptions / N
cum = previous_cum + new_rate
# By group
A_idx = indices where signal.node_groups == 'A'
B_idx = indices where signal.node_groups == 'B'
rate_A = mean(state.person_adopted[A_idx])
rate_B = mean(state.person_adopted[B_idx])
# Exposure average
exp_avg = mean(policy.exposure_vector)
# Reporting delay buffer
push (rate, new_rate, cum, rate_A, rate_B, exp_avg) into a FIFO buffer of length parameters.reporting_delay_days
if buffer not yet full:
  emit zeros or last known values
else:
  emit buffered oldest values, optionally smoothed by moving average of window parameters.smoothing_window_days
# Time to 50% computed once when cumulative first crosses 0.5
if not set time_to_50:
  if cum >= 0.5:
    observable.time_to_50_day = t
else:
  keep previous value
notes: Smoothing applies a centered moving average to mitigate noise.
If reporting_delay_days = 0, values are emitted immediately.

algorithms.DegreeCorrectedSBM_with_TriadicClosure: Generates a homophilous, clustered contact network with prescribed degree heterogeneity.
algorithms.DailyEdgeActivation: Bernoulli activation of edges each day to model contact opportunities.
algorithms.TargetedExposureAllocation: Allocates campaign budget by strategy to maximize or shape exposure.
algorithms.WeightedLinearThreshold_Heterogeneous: Adoption occurs when susceptibility-weighted influence plus exogenous exposure exceeds an agent-specific threshold.
algorithms.SatisfactionModulatedAbandonment: Adopted agents abandon with a hazard decreasing in satisfaction, which evolves by social reinforcement and decay.
